preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text only.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: First line is T (number of test cases), followed by T lines each containing exactly two space-separated integers X and Y.
No line in input is empty or contains only whitespace.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == int(line.split()[0]) and int(line.split()[1]) == int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: All integers X and Y in test cases are valid integers within the constraints.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '' or all(len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0].isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Output consists of T lines, each containing a single non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rounds for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= 10**9 for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid non-negative number of rounds.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == min_rounds(int(X), int(Y)) for i, (X, Y) in enumerate([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum number of rounds to reach Y from X using one positive odd integer a and one positive even integer b, where each round can either add a or subtract b.
